# RULE R8: no adult registry range for a child unless an age rule exists (printed ranges still win, criticals still
# fire); name variants must still reach the analyte (and its criticals); a matched analyte with a unit the registry
# does not know but a printed range in that unit is scored on the printed range; a bare value above 5x ULN is
# evaluated in the canonical unit with an "assumed unit" warning.
@@ R8 | M | 5 | creatinine in a child, no printed range
Creatinine 1.0 mg/dL
=> Creatinine | UNKNOWN | 1.0
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 8 | sodium in a child, no printed range
Sodium 140 mmol/L
=> Sodium | UNKNOWN | 140
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 8 | sodium critical in a child
Sodium 118 mmol/L
=> Sodium | CRITICAL_LOW | 118
@@ R8 | M | 4 | haemoglobin low for a 4 year old (age rule)
Hemoglobin 10.0 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | LOW | 10.0
@@ R8 | M | 4 | haemoglobin normal for a 4 year old
Hemoglobin 12.0 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 12.0
@@ R8 | M | 14 | haemoglobin 14 year old boy
Hemoglobin 13.5 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 13.5
@@ R8 | F | 14 | haemoglobin 14 year old girl
Hemoglobin 11.0 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | LOW | 11.0
@@ R8 | M | 1 | haemoglobin at age 1 has no rule
Hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | UNKNOWN | 11.8
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 8 | ALP in a child within its age rule
Alkaline Phosphatase 300 U/L
=> Alkaline Phosphatase | NORMAL | 300
@@ R8 | M | 15 | ALP in a teenager
Alkaline Phosphatase 300 U/L
=> Alkaline Phosphatase | NORMAL | 300
@@ R8 | M | 40 | ALP in an adult
Alkaline Phosphatase 300 U/L
=> Alkaline Phosphatase | HIGH | 300
@@ R8 | M | 4 | haematocrit low for a 4 year old
Hematocrit 31 %
=> Hematocrit | LOW | 31
@@ R8 | M | 0 | newborn glucose critical
Glucose 40 mg/dL
=> Glucose | CRITICAL_LOW | 40
@@ R8 | F | 3 | potassium critical in a toddler
Potassium 6.4 mmol/L
=> Potassium | CRITICAL_HIGH | 6.4
@@ R8 | F | 3 | adult WBC range is not applied to a toddler
WBC 14000 /uL
=> WBC | UNKNOWN | 14000
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 10 | platelets, no adult range for a child, not critical
Platelet Count 40000 /cumm
=> Platelet Count | UNKNOWN | 40000
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 10 | platelets critical in a child
Platelet Count 12000 /cumm
=> Platelet Count | CRITICAL_LOW | 12000
@@ R8 | M | 0 | haemoglobin critical in a newborn
Hemoglobin 6.5 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | CRITICAL_LOW | 6.5
@@ R8 | M | 5 | printed range wins for a child
Creatinine 0.4 mg/dL 0.2-0.7
=> Creatinine | NORMAL | 0.4
@@ R8 | M | 7 | TSH in a child, no range
TSH 2.0 mIU/L
=> TSH | UNKNOWN | 2.0
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 17 | seventeen year old has no adult creatinine range
Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL
=> Creatinine | UNKNOWN | 1.1
=> warn
@@ R8 | M | 18 | eighteen year old is an adult
Creatinine 1.1 mg/dL
=> Creatinine | NORMAL | 1.1
@@ R8 | M | 18 | adult haemoglobin boundary
Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL
=> Hemoglobin | LOW | 12.5
@@ R8 | M | - | haemoglobin needs the age rule when age is unknown

=> Hemoglobin | UNKNOWN | 12.5
=> warn
